Hamburg-based software company Procuros has raised €20 million in a Series A funding round to further develop its AI-native supply chain connectivity platform and expand internationally.
Procuros is building the infrastructure for autonomous supply chains. Its platform enables suppliers and retailers to exchange reliable, harmonized data regardless of the systems or formats they use.
The round was led by XAnge, with existing investors Point Nine, Creandum and b2venture participating alongside several angel investors.

products.name: Procuros AI-native supply chain connectivity platform
products.description: AI原生的B2B连接基础设施，让企业只需连接一次即可与众多贸易伙伴交换订单、发票、发货通知等数据，无需逐一集成，替代碎片化的EDI系统、PDF和电子表格。
products.target_customers: 供应商与零售商，包括食品制造商与分销商、美妆零售商等
features: 单一接口连接多个贸易伙伴
自动交换订单、订单响应、发货通知、发票和贷项通知单
将采购订单、确认和数量/交期变更捕获为结构化数据并自动传输至ERP（如Microsoft Business Central）
支持食品行业特定需求，如包装标签引用、质量文档、EUDR可追溯性数据

evidence_refs.quote: Procuros runs an AI-native platform that connects supply chains, replacing fragmented integrations with a single interface. Companies connect once and exchange orders, invoices, and shipping notices with many trading partners, regardless of their systems or data formats.
Procuros automates workflows across five core document types: orders, order responses, shipping notices, invoices and credit notes.

customers.name: KoRo
customers.use_case: 通过Procuros连接300+供应商和欧洲大型零售商，自动交换订单、确认、发货通知、发票和贷项通知单，将结构化数据传入Microsoft Business Central，减少人工处理。

evidence_refs.quote: KoRo chose Procuros as the AI-native connectivity layer between Microsoft Business Central and its entire trading network — across both suppliers and retailers.

quotes.speaker: Valerie Bures-Bönström
quotes.quote: Procuros shows that AI agents can already make autonomous B2B commerce a reality. The team has built the infrastructure these agents need to operate across entire trading networks, and has already proven that this model can scale in the DACH region. What excites us is the opportunity to take this technology beyond its home market and help create a new category for global B2B commerce.

quotes.speaker: Matthias Hoffmann
quotes.quote: Procuros has taken an immense amount of manual work off our plate and given us a single source of truth – which has been a real game changer for us. In food supply chains, a missing confirmation, changed quantity or delayed delivery can quickly become an availability issue. With Procuros, we bring supplier and retailer communication into one structured process around Business Central, allowing our teams to focus on the topics that actually move the needle.

analysis.capital_judgment: 资本押注的核心变量是Procuros能否将已在DACH地区验证的AI原生B2B连接基础设施规模化，并成功拓展至欧洲和美国市场。当前融资所依赖的已验证信号包括：超过300家客户、年化订单量超过€30亿、以及KoRo等客户的实际部署效果（如90%人工处理时间减少）。判断的证据边界在于：来源未披露本轮估值、收入或盈利数据，也未提供美国市场拓展的具体进展或客户承诺，因此资本判断主要基于客户规模与网络效应，而非财务回报验证。
